event_records.description: Sanjay submits his resignation notice to his manager.

sanjay.name: Sanjay
sanjay.persona_brief:
You are Sanjay.
Sanjay has just handed in his notice at Nimbus Freight this morning. He leads the only team that understands the legacy routing system. He has an outside offer with a thirty percent salary increase. He is uncertain whether his manager will make a counteroffer.

sanjay_s_manager.name: Sanjay's manager
sanjay_s_manager.persona_brief:
You are Sanjay's manager.
Sanjay's manager has lost two engineers this year and has an open requisition she has struggled to fill. She has just received Sanjay's resignation notice this morning. She must decide whether to make a counteroffer to retain him.

resolution.question: Sanjay handed in his notice at Nimbus Freight this morning. Will his manager come back with a counteroffer within five working days?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Sanjay's manager communicated a counteroffer to Sanjay before 2026-08-03T18:00:00+05:30. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
